title: Give me prompt for asking chatgpt…

messages.text: give me prompt for asking chatgpt to rate my resume

Sure, Hemanth! Here’s a prompt you can use:

"Can you please review and rate my resume based on the criteria of a strong technical and soft skill set? Here’s my resume: [paste your resume here]."

This should give ChatGPT a clear idea of what you need. Let me know if you need any more help! 📄✨
